alt: A marble statue of a seated Muse, her robe gathered over her knees, her head turned to one side.
A marble bust of Herodotus, bearded, with his name carved on the front of the bust.
A marble portrait head of Demosthenes, with a short beard and a furrowed brow.
A headless marble statue of a man wearing a toga, its heavy folds wrapped over one arm.
A small bronze statuette of Apollo standing on a square base, holding a bow.
A marble head of a bearded Greek philosopher with a lined forehead.
A broken marble fragment of an Athenian decree, its letters cut in neat rows and columns.
A marble grave stele of a little girl in a long robe, holding two doves, one of them close to her face.
A small marble statue of a young athlete, his head turned to one side, his arms broken away.
A fragment of a marble relief with Nike, goddess of victory, her drapery blowing about her.
A small bronze herm: a pillar topped with a bearded head, with short arms like a cross.
A bronze statuette of Hermes, standing, a cloak over his shoulder.
A bronze statuette of a diskos thrower, holding the diskos up in his left hand.
A marble head of a young woman, perhaps a Muse, with her hair gathered up in curls.
A small Cycladic marble figure of a man seated on a chair, playing a harp.
A marble fragment of an Athenian tribute list, with large letters in columns.
A marble relief fragment carved with prizes of the games: a jar, a wreath and a shield, with Greek words cut in and beside them.
A long grey marble statue base with three lines of Greek letters carved across its face.
A marble head of a Greek general wearing a helmet pushed back on his head.
A marble statue of a seated man, his head and arms lost, a cloak over his lap.
A marble votive relief: a hero reclines at a banquet while worshippers approach from the left.
A bronze statuette of Hermes seated on a rock.
A marble statue of Hermes standing, a cloak over his left arm.
A marble grave stele of Eukleia, topped with a small pediment, with a tall vase carved in relief.
A small marble portrait head of the Stoic philosopher Chrysippus, bald and bearded.
A marble grave relief in two bands: a funerary banquet above, warriors departing below.
A marble portrait bust of an elderly man, his face deeply lined.
A small bronze statuette of Herakles striding forward, his right arm raised.
A headless marble statue of Eirene, the personification of peace, in a long robe with deep folds.
A marble kouros: a standing naked youth, arms at his sides, left foot forward, his long hair beaded.
A tall marble funerary vase, a lekythos, carved in relief with figures around its body.
A marble left hand holding a rolled scroll.
A bronze statuette of Neptune (Poseidon) standing, a cloak over his left arm, his right arm raised.
A terracotta statuette of the Diadoumenos, a young athlete raising both arms to tie a band around his head.
A marble grave stele of a family: a bearded man seated at its centre, a woman standing behind him, a small child at the right.
A marble grave stele under a pediment: a woman seated on a chair, with two figures standing beside her.
A terracotta statuette of an old teacher seated at a box, with a small pupil standing at his side.
A marble portrait head of an elderly man with a lined face.
A small bronze statuette of a boy wrapped in his cloak, in the pose of an orator, on a round base.
A marble head of Athena with a decorated band over her hair.
A marble head of Apollo with curling hair, a fragment of his hand resting on his head.
A marble head and upper body of Athena, her robe falling in folds over her shoulders.
A broken corner of a marble votive relief, with a figure of Athena.
A limestone plaque inscribed in two languages, Latin above and Greek below.
A small inscribed base of red marble, with Greek letters on its stepped faces.
The head of a youth carved in relief, broken from a marble grave stele.
